output.title: OperatorHub packages discontinued: install method not shown for OperatorHub
output.content: The notes say OperatorHub packages are no longer published and v1.16.5 was the last release there. The environment's installed products show cert-manager through label, flux-helmrelease, argocd-application, helm-annotation and helmfile sources, none of which is OperatorHub. The summary does not rule out an OperatorHub or OLM install elsewhere. Check that no cluster installs cert-manager through OperatorHub or OLM.
